caption: "dante moore" — 1,000,000+ searches this week. Oregon's quarterback left the field in an ambulance.

Why: On September 26 at USC, linebacker Desman Stephens II hit Moore late as he slid. Stephens was ejected for targeting, and USC later suspended him for 1 game. Oregon says Moore has a concussion and his MRI and CT scans were clean. Backup Dylan Raiola threw for 289 yards in a 41-27 win.
What most people don't know: Moore could already be in the NFL. In January he turned down the 2026 draft, where CBS Sports ranked him the No. 2 prospect, to play one more season at Oregon.
Very simply put: staying one more season was his choice. The late hit was not.

slides.headline: Passed on a likely top-5 pick. Saturday he left in an *ambulance*.
slides.sub: 10 things most people don't know about Dante Moore, searched 1,000,000+ times in the US this week.
